اقتلعتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعَتَا (iqtalaʕatā) /iq.ta.la.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعَتَا (uqtuliʕatā) /uq.tu.li.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
